intro: Call of Earth is a sacred trial in which an elemental initiate drinks an Earth Sapta at the Rise of Spirits to pierce the veil between worlds. Guided by an elemental spirit, the seeker learns the endurance and steadfast resolve of the earth as the foundation for rekindling their lost bond with the winds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few adventurer know the recipe.
The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.
Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... Well, you will see what you need to see.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah... Friend... Child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.

I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.
